reviewer: Claude Code (agent self-review; not an independent review)
note: Candidate inventory only. It is not the approved registry: docs/organisation/skills.json is unchanged and still has no entries. 'state' is where a candidate is in review; 'recommendation' is the agent's proposal. Only an owner_decision may move a candidate to approved, rejected or revoked. A schema-valid owner_decision is not proof that the owner made it: see 'Owner decisions' in skill-catalogue-audit.md.

approve.rules: approved_sha256 must equal the entry's tree_sha256. The approval covers that exact content and the stated scope (stages or projects) only. Any content change returns the entry to under-review.

reject.rules: Rejects the candidate as reviewed. No hash binding: a later revision can be re-proposed as a new review.

revoke.rules: Withdraws an earlier approval. 'revokes' cites that approve decision's reference, and revoked_sha256 is the hash it approved. Takes effect from 'date'; it does not uninstall anything, and the skill may not be loaded for KAREN work afterwards. Re-approval needs a new approve decision.

locations.shared-agents-skills: User-level shared skill folder installed by the Skills CLI. Claude Code reaches it through symlinks in its user skill folder.
locations.claude-user-skills: Claude Code user skill folder, holding real directories that are not symlinks.

hash_method: skill_md_sha256 is SHA-256 of SKILL.md. tree_sha256 is SHA-256 over sorted lines 'relative-path NUL file-sha256'. upstream_match compares SKILL.md with the source repository's default branch on 2026-11-23. For a plugin, tree_sha256 covers its runtime files only: the .claude-plugin, .codex-plugin, hooks and skills folders, listed in pinned_files.

Network: only the optional webhook (HTTPS, or plain HTTP to localhost), off by default. Credentials: only the optional webhook token, held in the system keychain. Data inventory and plan: docs/organisation/ponytail.md.
candidates.rationale: Owner decision 2026-11-23: full plugin, not skill-only, with every capability kept and subordinate to KAREN OS policy. Owner decisions 2026-11-24: pin release v5.3.3, unmodified; install in both runtimes with Codex hooks trusted; transcript import allowed; upstream-default ledger with no KAREN retention; no webhook; status line allowed; Engineering HQ option C (board only). Install still needs an owner approval bound to tree_sha256. Earlier conditions were the owner decisions in docs/organisation/ponytail.md: pinned ref, marketplace install in both runtimes, transcript scope, ledger location and retention, webhook destination, payload, token, status-line edit and the Engineering HQ option.
